# AstryxDivider { #anylumino.AstryxDivider }

```python
AstryxDivider(orientation='horizontal', variant='subtle', **props)
```

Render an Astryx divider.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name        | Type   | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           | Default        |
|-------------|--------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|----------------|
| orientation | str    | Astryx component option.                                                                                                                                                                                                                              | `'horizontal'` |
| variant     | str    | Astryx visual variant.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                | `'subtle'`     |
| **props     | Any    | JSON-safe Divider props. Useful keys: label, isFullBleed, className, and style. The orientation prop supports horizontal and vertical; variant supports subtle and strong. See Astryx component docs: <https://astryx.atmeta.com/components/Divider>. | `{}`           |
